title: Ruby Modules Basics
intro: Ruby modules interview questions cover two key uses: namespacing and mixins. This module covers the module as namespace (module Animals; class Dog; end; end → Animals::Dog), include for adding instance methods to a class, extend for adding module methods as class-level methods, the basic include vs extend difference, Enumerable — what you get for implementing each (map, select, sort, min, max, group_by, and more), Comparable — what you get for implementing <=> (all comparison operators and between? and clamp), why Ruby uses modules for mixins instead of multiple inheritance, and the ancestors chain as the simple mental model for method lookup. Examples stay at beginner level — no prepend, no MRO tracing.
